name: River Development Agent Controlled Execution Verification Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTION VERIFICATION FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-284 consumes only the exact DEV-283 controlled execution attestation result contract.
DEV-284 denies verification when the DEV-283 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, unattested, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required attestation evidence.
DEV-284 creates deterministic verification data only.
DEV-284 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-284 does not retry execution.
DEV-284 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-284 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-284 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-284 preserves predecessor provenance and the complete execution/attestation evidence chain.
DEV-284 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-284 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-284 does not modify repository content.
DEV-284 does not delete repository content.
DEV-284 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-284 does not commit.
DEV-284 does not push.
DEV-284 does not deploy.
DEV-284 does not access secrets.
DEV-284 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-284 does not perform network execution.
DEV-284 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution certification boundary is required before downstream progression.
